For Geneva clients, performs pricing of funds’ investments using prices from external sources. Ensures that the monthly partners’ allocation is allocating the correct profit and loss based on the straight capital ratios or commitment ratios, whichever is the case maybe. Ensures that management fees and performance fees are allocating according to the limited partnership agreements. Ensures that all expenses are accrued, and all income and expense items are recognized in the appropriate tabs in the allocation file. Ensures that all income and expenses are classified in the right income and expense character for income tax purposes. Ensures the correctness of the monthly, quarterly and year to date gross and net returns for each limited partner. Ensures that all working papers are appropriately labeled and with proper notations and/or cell comments. Prepares the reporting package for next level review. Monitors client mailboxes/distribution lists and saves all necessary emails and supports on a timely manner. Prepares ad hoc requests received from client, including but not limited to, distributions, drawdowns, etc. Prepares wire entries in the treasury portal for engagements with Cash Control services. Performs peer review of Investor statements, as needed. Assists in coordinating annual audits of clients’ financial statements. Prepares working papers in a way that ensures that all audit requirements are handy for the auditors. Prepares year-end schedules for independent auditors including cost roll forward, cash reconciliation, statement of cash flows, and financial highlights and other working papers supporting the balances and disclosures in the financial statements. Prepares each fund’s financial statements and works closely with the respective fund’s auditors for note disclosures. Prepares and submits draft financial statements on a timely basis for next level review. Organizes own work, setting priorities and meeting critical deadlines. review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: NO Sponsorship offered FULLY ONSITE (don't apply if you can't go to the Delray beach office) NO 3rd PARTY AGENCIES We ship fast, often several releases a week, and we build with AI-assisted development as a core practice. We are hiring a Senior Application Developer to raise the bar on how we build: establish and lead a formal software development lifecycle (SDLC), raise code quality, own application security inside our apps, mentor a growing team of developers, and deliver new apps end to end with the business. What you'll do Build and ship business apps end to end. Partner with our product managers and their business users in sales, operations, logistics, purchasing and finance to turn product requirements and roadmaps into Python/Dash and web applications, from data model to deployed container. Establish and run our SDLC. Define and roll out a practical software development lifecycle for the team: intake and requirements with product managers, design review, coding standards, code review, testing and QA, versioned releases, dev-to-production promotion, change management, rollback, documentation and post-release support. Coach the team in using it and improve it over time. Own security inside the apps. Lead authentication and authorization across apps, including the central Pero Central portal and the signed tokens it passes to other apps; remove hard-coded credentials; apply secure coding practices. Write and tune the data layer. Design T-SQL views, stored procedures and indexes on Azure SQL; make slow screens fast through query tuning, caching and smarter data loading. Keep the UI standard. Maintain our shared Dash app template and UI standard (grids, filters, export, theming) so every app looks and behaves the same. Modernize legacy tools. Convert stand-alone HTML/React and Node apps into maintainable Dash apps on the shared template with full feature parity. Lead and mentor. Review pull requests, pair with junior developers and analysts, write onboarding guides, and set coding standards for a team that is growing. Use AI well. Build with AI coding assistants every day, and build AI features (Claude API, retrieval-augmented search, MCP integrations) where they help the business. You will partner with our Azure Infrastructure & Security Specialist, who owns cloud networking, database platforms and infrastructure security. Applications Python, Plotly Dash, Flask, Dash AG Grid, Plotly charts; some Node.js/Express and React Data Azure SQL (T-SQL views, stored procedures), pandas, pyodbc, Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory feeds from ERP/WMS and EDI Hosting Docker, Azure Container Apps, Azure Container Registry, gunicorn Source and release GitHub, branch-based reviews, versioned image tags Identity Microsoft Entra ID, a central portal that issues signed tokens to apps AI Claude Code and other AI coding assistants, Claude API, RAG, MCP servers What you bring 7+ years in a custom software development environment, such as an in-house development team or a software consultancy, writing bespoke applications from the ground up rather than configuring packaged software; including 3+ years as a senior or lead developer. Strong Python, including web apps with Dash, Flask or a similar framework, and pandas for data work. Strong SQL: complex T-SQL queries, views, stored procedures, indexing and performance tuning.
